prompt:
Create a polished engineering documentation STORYBOARD, one landscape image approximately 1536x1024, six illustrated panels arranged three columns by two rows, read left-to-right across each row. This is a public GitHub README overview of two complementary components, not a mockup of an implemented application. Editorial technical illustration: warm ivory canvas, charcoal ink, muted teal for QVCH, muted indigo for UWH, restrained amber for uncertainty, spacious gutters, clear large typography, subtle isometric desk/workspace scenes, credible adult professionals and abstract documents. Professional, welcoming, precise; no cartoons of robots, neon, holograms, badges, fake certifications or ornamental equations.
Top title exactly: "QVCH + UWH"
Under it two separate readable lines exactly:
"Qualified Verification and Control Harness"
"Universal Work Harness"
Then a small relationship line exactly: "QVCH frames the work. UWH coordinates it."
Six panels with these EXACT large headings and short captions, each with a concrete illustration:
01 "Orient" caption "Outcome • People • Constraints". Show a person framing a proposed document review at a desk with a project map, people and boundary cards. Small corner label "QVCH".
02 "Choose guidance" caption "Purpose • Sources • Evidence". Show that person selecting a few method cards from a library and connecting a source document to a verification checklist. Small corner label "QVCH".
03 "Agree scope" caption "Owner • Recipient • Reviewer". Show two people exchanging a clearly bounded assignment document with a separate reviewer nearby; the recipient considers an offer, no automatic acceptance stamp. Small corner label "UWH".
04 "Perform bounded work" caption "Approved scope • Supported tools". Show human and software assistance inspecting documents in a clearly outlined workspace, work boundary visible, no publication or deployment arrows. Small corner label "UWH".
05 "Verify evidence" caption "Checks • Findings • Unknowns". Show source documents and a magnifying glass compared with evidence cards, one amber question mark remaining; do not depict all-green proof. Small corner label "QVCH + UWH".
06 "Human review" caption "Accept • Rework • Hold". Show an actual human reviewer reading a result and considering three equally available decision cards; none automatically selected. Small corner label "UWH".
Use restrained directional cues connecting 01 to 02 to 03, then 03 down/left to 04, then 04 to 05 to 06 without ambiguous arrows. No independent second router or autonomous corrective control. Keep scenes uncluttered and give all text breathing room. Footer exactly: "Concept storyboard • Authority and acceptance remain human-led"
Spell all supplied text correctly, especially Qualified Verification and Control Harness and Universal Work Harness. Do not introduce the former words Quantum, Vibe or Unified. Do not add extra explanatory prose or pretend this proves safety, compliance, host qualification or live execution.
source_state: Working-tree documentation with owner-requested naming updates; source byte hashes recorded in coverage sources.
human_acceptance: accepted for documentation publication; see owner-acceptance.md
publication: authorized; publication result recorded in pull request
